The metric "Median tid fra ankomst til sygehus til modtagelse af antibiotika" measures the median time in minutes from a patient's arrival at a hospital to the administration of antibiotics, a critical indicator for treating severe infections. An analysis of the 2024 data across Denmark's regions and hospital units reveals significant variation in treatment speed [^src1]. Because the available data consists of a single dated section, no longitudinal trends can be established regarding whether treatment times are improving or declining over time [^src1].

Nationally, the median time across 3,592 recorded cases is 264 minutes [^src1]. However, performance varies widely at the hospital level. The fastest-performing units (leaders) include Regionshospitalet Randers, which recorded the lowest median time of 157 minutes, followed by Holbæk Sygehus (191 minutes), Hospitalerne i Nordsjælland (197 minutes), and Aarhus Universitetshospital (201 minutes) [^src1]. Conversely, the slowest-performing units (trailers) are Sygehus Lillebælt with a median of 439 minutes, Esbjerg Sygehus Grindsted Sygehus at 477 minutes, and Rigshospitalet at 503 minutes [^src1].

Several outliers stand out in the distribution of treatment times. Sygehus Lillebælt exhibits an extreme upper quartile (Q3) of 2,695 minutes, indicating that a significant portion of patients experience severe delays [^src1]. Similarly, Rigshospitalet shows a high Q3 of 1,294 minutes alongside its high median, and Odense Universitetshospital - Svendborg records a Q3 of 1,349 minutes [^src1]. In contrast, Bornholms Hospital demonstrates a tightly clustered distribution with a median of 205 minutes and a Q3 of just 294 minutes, suggesting highly consistent treatment times despite a smaller sample size of 28 cases [^src1]. The data does not specify a formal target or threshold time for antibiotic administration, making it impossible to evaluate whether specific units met or missed official clinical standards based solely on this table [^src1]. This metric is tracked as part of [[indikator-1|Indikator 1]].
